answer: Cross-chain binding at the violet badge: one identity locks a PoA bond on chain A and a mirrored bond on chain B, provably linked by hash-time-locked proofs. An ivory auditor verifies both bonds are unspent each epoch. Running n clones costs 2n bonds plus n juniper bridge fees — a 1,000-fake farm burns ~240,000 POA, unrecoverable if either side slashes. Cost scales linearly per fake, payoff does not, so farming goes negative fast.
